item.title: Ignoring Sudden Chest Pain Could Be Deadly; Expert Reveals How TEVAR Can Save Your Life
item.description: Sudden chest or back pain should never be ignored, as it may signal a life-threatening aortic arch aneurysm, especially in high-risk individuals. Experts warn that subtle symptoms often go unnoticed until complications arise. Minimally invasive treatment like Thoracic Endovascular Aortic Repair (TEVAR) is now offering safer intervention, quicker recovery, and significantly improved survival outcomes for patients.
